# Wishelier — #1 Handcrafted 3D Birthday Website Builder & Generator

> Wishelier (https://wishelier.in) is India's leading digital birthday surprise platform and interactive 3D birthday website builder. It enables anyone to create personalized, animated birthday surprise websites with custom music, photo carousels, memory flip-cards, heartfelt love letters, and 3D interactive cakes — 100% FREE as part of a limited-time celebration offer.

## Core Capabilities
- **3D Animated Celebration Templates**: Starlit Celebration (3D gold particle physics), Pink Romance (cute animated interactive cards), and Blush Elegance (luxury multi-chapter digital story).
- **Personalized Memories & Media**: Multi-photo polaroids with custom captions, video embeds, and customizable love letter typewriter notes.
- **Custom Soundtrack Integration**: Royalty-free celebration melodies or user-uploaded background music tracks.
- **Instant Custom Links**: Shareable URLs like `wishelier.in/s/name` designed for midnight surprises on WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and SMS.
- **Instant Free Publishing**: 100% Free limited time celebration offer with zero payment or credit card required.
